entries.title: Sen. Bill Hagerty Creates Legal Defense Fund Over Biden-Era ‘Arctic Frost’ Investigation
entries.summary: The Tennessee Republican is the first known lawmaker to form such a fund for this purpose.
entries.content:
Sen. Bill Hagerty has created a legal defense fund in response to the Biden administration’s “Arctic Frost” investigation, which probed some federal lawmakers’ phone records related to President Donald Trump’s efforts to overturn the results of the 2020 presidential election.

The fund is “is necessitated by, and intended to defray, legal expenses and related expenses I incur and am responsible for in connection with proceedings arising from the acquisition of cell phone records by the Federal Bureau of Investigation related to my service as a Member of the United States Senate,” Hagerty wrote in an affidavit included in the defense fund’s organizational documents, which NOTUS obtained from the U.S. Senate.

The documents, first reported by Tennessee Lookout, indicate Hagerty is represented by David Thompson and Clark Hildabrand of Cooper & Kirk. The trustee of the fund is John Rader, Hagerty’s former chief of staff.
entries.author: Torrie Herrington

entries.title: Mike Johnson on Iran Conflict: ‘Mission Is Virtually Accomplished’
entries.summary: The House speaker also said on the On NOTUS podcast that he thinks Republicans will “defy history” and keep their majority in November.
entries.content:
Speaker Mike Johnson said he thinks the Trump administration’s war on Iran will “come to a close soon” following the president’s speech this week at the House Republican Conference’s policy retreat in Doral, Florida.

“The mission is virtually accomplished now as it was defined,” Johnson told NOTUS’ Reese Gorman on the latest episode of the On NOTUS podcast. “And I think that’ll happen. That’s his intention, and he’s saying the same thing to us privately as he says publicly.”

In his speech addressing the House Republicans at the retreat, President Donald Trump said gas prices might continue to rise for a short period due to the conflict.
entries.author: Nora Toscano
